title: Worker hello answer
description: The hub's 200 answer to POST /api/station/stt/hello (WorkerApi.handle, sizeup/cloud/sttworkers.py). The worker client reads `worker`, `poll_s`, `pool_on` and `classes` and ignores the rest.

worker.description: The id the hub knows this token as: a GPU worker's id, or `station:<id>` for a station's whisper.

poll_s.description: How long a claim's long poll may wait, seconds. The worker never waits longer.

pool_on.description: The pool is on and has a worker in it.

classes.description: The pool classes that are switched on now.

worker_update.title: Worker update
worker_update.description: Only to a GPU worker that sent `self_update`: the version the hub wants it on (sizeup/cloud/sttworkers.py WorkerApi.wanted). The worker takes it only from main of actualsecurity/sizeup on GitHub, with exactly this hash, and never uses `url`.

mode.description: `auto`: the hub's own build; `pin`: a version an admin chose; `hold`: none (no commit or hash). A worker takes a word it does not know as `hold`.

commit.description: A commit on main. Absent with `hold`, and with `auto` while the hub can't tell its build (a local run).

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of tools/stt_worker/worker.py at that commit.

url.description: For people: raw.githubusercontent.com's address of that file. The worker builds its own.
